title: Owner: accept the backup plan or the recorded gap
goal: The owner accepts FPVBuddy's durability before the import
acceptance: The owner accepts the F-016-T01 plan, or accepts the named gap with its date; with a gap accepted, F-016-T03 and F-016-T04 are cancelled with that reason
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one decision; its page is the record section F-016-T01 writes. Not a measurement.
